candidate.bug_signature: importlib mode misclassifies namespace package when directory contains same-named module file
candidate.repro_summary: Create a project containing cow/moo/moo.py and cow/moo/test_moo.py, where the test imports from cow.moo.moo, then run pytest with --import-mode=importlib.
candidate.bad_behavior: Pytest raises an ImportError during collection because PathFinder.find_spec is asked to resolve the namespace path with both the directory and same-named module file, causing cow.moo and cow.moo.moo to be classified incorrectly.
candidate.expected_behavior: Pytest should collect and run the test successfully, importing cow.moo as a namespace package and cow.moo.moo as the module file.
candidate.preserved_behavior: Assertion rewriting should still be available for real module files imported from subdirectories, including the behavior covered by the prior #12659 regression.
edge_cases: Same layout should pass under --import-mode=importlib when the test imports a value from the same-named module file.
Plain namespace packages without a same-named module file should remain importable.
Assertion rewriting for subdirectory module files should not regress.
